Hi all — thanks for looping me in. Quick answers to the procurement questions and a suggested packaging we can present to Acme: 

1) Marketplace vs direct PO
- We publish an AWS Marketplace listing. Marketplace purchases provide faster procurement for many customers but carry a marketplace fee (~15%). Marketplace does support reserved SKUs, but reserved pricing via marketplace is typically annual and requires the marketplace contract/purchase flow.

2) Payment methods & thresholds
- Card: allowed for pilots up to $10k.
- Direct PO (invoiced): available for any deal but subject to minimums for manual processing; we typically ask for a $25k initial PO for invoiced deals to avoid admin overhead. Net 30 is standard; Net 45 can be requested via finance approval.

3) Packaging options (recommended)
- Hosted (on-demand): No commit. Billed per token/hour. Fastest to start — good for feature validation.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): 12-month or 3-month reserved options. 12-month commit gets the largest discount (~25–35% depending on size). Pricing workbook (attached) has banded T-shirt sizes (S/M/L/XL) with throughput guarantees and unit economics.
- Private (VPC/on‑prem): Enterprise packaged deal — usually includes one-time deployment/validation fees plus annual support. Longer procurement timeline (legal + security).

4) Commit conversion credit
- If a customer starts on Hosted and later converts to Dedicated, we offer credit for consumed usage during the prior 90 days up to 50% of the initial committed amount (details in the SOW).

Attachments: Pricing_Tiers_Q4_2026.xlsx; Marketplace_Fees.md

Suggested next steps for Acme:
- Sarah/Angela: confirm whether procurement wants us to surface a marketplace SKU (faster) or a direct PO quote (preferred for margins).
- If PO path: confirm billing entity name and tax ID and send a sample PO template.
- If marketplace: we will provide the marketplace SKU and expected annual cost with the fee included.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with procurement if that helps — Marissa and I can join.

Best,
